# fitCurvedDecals

## Summary

Deterministic decal fitting in the img-to-3d pipeline, reached here through the spec-passes barrel module (`index` re-exports every pass; the implementation lives in `./attachments`). A curvedDecal must hug the body it attaches to, but the authored radius is only probabilistically right — too large reads as a label floating beside the bottle. It walks each decal's `attachTo` chain to the first solid host, centres the decal on the host axis, fits its radius to the host's real radius at the decal's own height (+0.01 skin, sampling lathe profiles within the band), clamps its height and vertical centre into the host, and slims cylinders riding a lathe neck to 1.3× the wall radius.

## Import

```ts
import { fitCurvedDecals } from '../util/spec-passes/index';
```

## Usage

The studio calls it in `applyParsedSpec` and again after `reconcileProportions` corrections; it is not part of `runStructurePasses`. Mutates dimensions/positions in place; returns log lines.
